gazimuseumsamsun.name: Gazi Museum
gazimuseumsamsun.slogan: The rooms where a republic began to take shape.
gazimuseumsamsun.line: Gentlemen, I landed at Samsun on the 19th May, 1919.

sinopcezaevi.name: Sinop Fortress Prison
sinopcezaevi.slogan: Walls above the sea that held poets and rebels.
sinopcezaevi.line: Built in 1887 inside Sinop's old fortress, it housed inmates until 1997 and was nicknamed the Anatolian Alcatraz.

onuranitisamsun.name: Statue of Honour
onuranitisamsun.slogan: Atatürk on horseback, watching over Samsun's square.
onuranitisamsun.line: Austrian sculptor Heinrich Krippel completed this Atatürk monument in 1931.

inceburunfeneri.name: İnceburun Lighthouse
inceburunfeneri.slogan: A lamp on the last cliff before Russia.
inceburunfeneri.line: Built in 1863 on the northernmost point of Anatolia, it still guides ships across the Black Sea.

hamsilos.name: Hamsilos Bay
hamsilos.slogan: A narrow green inlet with black sand and quiet water.
hamsilos.line: Often billed as Turkey's only fjord, it is really a cove, about 11 km west of Sinop.
